edit.new: (c) The person is acting in violation of an outstanding order of any court of competent jurisdiction arising out of the enforcement of ORS 658.405 to 658.511. (7)(a) A direct contractor or subcontractor commits a Class A misdemeanor if the direct contractor or subcontractor knowingly enters into a contract with a construction labor contractor who is required to be licensed under ORS 658.405 to 658.511 and who is not properly licensed under ORS 658.405 to 658.511. (b) A direct contractor or subcontractor commits a Class C felony if the direct contractor or subcontractor knowingly enters into a contract with a construction labor contractor who is required to be licensed under ORS 658.405 to 658.511 and who is not properly licensed under ORS 658.405 to 658.511, and the direct contractor or subcontractor has a prior conviction under this subsection at the time of the offense. (c) As used in this subsection: (A) “Construction labor contractor” has the meaning given that term in ORS 658.405, but does not include a person who is licensed under ORS chapter 701. (B) “Direct contractor” has the meaning given that term in ORS 652.197. (C) “Subcontractor” has the meaning given that term in ORS 652.197.
